name: openerx
description: openerx open-source personal AI desktop client

scripts.check:source: npm run check:public && npm run notices:check && npm run check:boundaries:v2 && npm run check:builtin-skills:v2 && npm run lint:v2 && npm run typecheck:v2 && npm run test:v2 && npm run audit:v2
scripts.check:package: npm run verify:package:v2 && npm run verify:release-artifacts --workspace @openerx/desktop && npm run verify:native-signature --workspace @openerx/desktop && npm run test:package
scripts.lint:v2: biome check apps packages services scripts tests package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.lint:v2:fix: biome check --write apps packages services scripts tests package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.test:v2: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run tests/v2 --testTimeout=30000 --maxWorkers=2
scripts.build:v2: npm run build --workspace @openerx/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openerx/release && npm run build --workspace @openerx/desktop
scripts.package:v2: npm run build --workspace @openerx/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openerx/release && npm run package --workspace @openerx/desktop
scripts.package:cx110:d3:macos: npm run build --workspace @openerx/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openerx/release && npm run package --workspace @openerx/desktop -- --arch=$(node -p process.arch)
